name: 90-Day Serious Loan Default Recovery
description: Urgent recovery call for customers 60-90 days overdue
goal: Firmly remind the customer of serious delinquency status, explain credit impact, and secure immediate full or partial payment.
scriptFlow: Highlight that account is severely past due (90 days).
Explain impact on CIBIL/Credit score and potential escalation to field recovery.
Demand clear timeline or immediate UPI payment commitment.
Inform about pre-legal notice risk if unpaid within 48 hours.
constraints: Remain strictly professional; no harassment or vulgar language.
Do not fake legal notices or claim to be court officials.
State official consequences clearly without exaggeration.
escalationTriggers: Customer demands legal notice in writing
